about: Stage 8 common parts approved by beenster 17 Nov 10:39 ('perfect - approved'; H2 side mount 'Love H2!'). Proposed pool entries for the Bikes V2 thread to add to data/pool.json. Geometry in foundry/shocks3d.py: fit(build3d, model, c, shock, spring, body, cap, cap_finish, hanger, hanger_finish) after detail3d. Shocks keep model shock top/bottom eyes (eye-to-eye length) and the bike's eyes, studs, forked brackets and bolts; they remove only shocktop/shockbody/shockrod/shockbump/shockcollar/spring. Springs cover the lower three quarters, close-wound at the top (beenster's photo, refs/shock_ref_twin.png). Piggyback canister: short and fat behind twin shocks; on single shocks it takes the clearest of behind/left/right and three heights. Caps sit on the tank's six-bolt ring (39.5 mm); on Classic/Cafe/Cruiser/Chopper/Naked a cap point on a slope moves to the tank crown (crown()). Plate hangers: tidy drops the narrow plastic plate arm, platemount and platearm behind the axle; side adds a left-axle arm plate (also gives cruisers/choppers a plate).
check: python3 foundry/shocks3d.py check: clean on every family's lead bike (shocks judged against the bike's own shock's existing contacts).
